decisions.why: Sub-Tenon and IVT injection sets are ophthalmic surgical consumable packs.
Phaco choppers and manipulators are cataract surgery consumables.
Punctal and lacrimal dilators are oculoplastic surgical consumables.
Bonn forceps are a named ophthalmic micro-surgical instrument.
Tongue depressor is an ENT surgical consumable.
Formby wax hook is a named ENT instrument for earwax removal.
Sold under the Ophthalmic Clamp division for ophthalmic surgical use.
Rampley sponge holders are a general surgical instrument.
BP scalpel handles are a general surgical instrument.
McDonald dissector is a general surgical instrument.
Lister utility forceps are a general surgical instrument.
